releases.title: Update system and release signing
changes: Added Download & Install update flow with Android package installer permission handling.
Added permanent release signing for reliable future APK updates.
Added GeoCraft mock-location registration for Android Developer Options.

releases.title: Place search and map improvements
changes: Added place and landmark search using OpenStreetMap Nominatim.
Added search-result selection to populate coordinates.
Fixed map gestures being intercepted by the surrounding screen.
Improved map interaction and location selection.

releases.title: Android release update
changes: Updated the GeoCraft Android release version.
Improved release-build preparation for subsequent updates.

releases.title: Initial public release
changes: Set custom latitude and longitude test locations.
Added Hyderabad, Delhi and Mumbai quick presets.
